lesson.title: Scarcity and urgency: why 'only 2 left' works
body: People value things more when they seem scarce or about to disappear. Marketers use this with stock counters ('only 2 left'), countdown timers and 'deal ends tonight' banners.

Used honestly, it helps buyers: a real limited run or a genuine sale end date is useful information. The problem is fake urgency, such as timers that reset when you reload the page or stock warnings that never change.

Black Friday is this Friday, so expect a lot of it. A simple check: reload the page or open it in a private window. If the timer restarts or the 'last few' count stays the same, the pressure isn't real.
lesson.takeaway: Urgency should be a fact, not a feeling. If a deal only works when you're rushed, pause and compare first.

m365.title: Schedule a Teams chat message to send later
m365.what: Teams can hold a chat message and send it at a time you choose. It's handy for messaging colleagues in other time zones or not pinging people out of hours.
try: Open a chat in Microsoft Teams and type your message as normal.
Instead of clicking Send, right-click the Send button (or press and hold it on mobile).
Choose 'Schedule message', pick a date and time, then select Send.
Before it goes, you'll see a note above the message showing when it will be sent; you can edit or cancel it there.

items.why: The claim (VP ≠ VNP) is unverified, and The Register notes the written proof runs to 250,000 pages. Treat AI 'breakthroughs' as pending until experts check them.

explainer.story: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
bullets: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after he left over an affair with an alleged spy. President Trump says 'I made the deal' (BBC).
Markets cheered: Nvidia's value climbed by almost $1tn and tech stocks rallied. The latest quote shows the S&P 500 up about 4.7% on the day.
The fallout continues: the US plans to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after the Nvidia scandal (BBC).
explainer.why: Nvidia makes the chips behind most AI, so its leadership moves the whole stock market and many pension and ISA funds.

term.meaning: The total value of a company on the stock market: its share price multiplied by the number of shares. Often shortened to 'market cap'.
term.example: Nvidia's market cap rose by almost $1tn in a day after Jensen Huang returned as CEO.
